findings.title: Your 10 costliest sessions made 41% of your usage
findings.text: Out of 120 sessions. A few long sessions drive most of the bill.
findings.action: Open them in the sessions table to see where each one grew.

findings.title: Replies past 150k context made 25% of your usage
findings.text: 1,397 replies, each re-reading at least 150k tokens of history; 43% of what they cost was that re-reading.
findings.action: Start a fresh session for each new task, so every reply re-reads less.

findings.title: Losing the cache cost $96.17, 18.7% of your usage
findings.text: The whole history was written again 213 times, mostly after breaks longer than the cache's life (155 times).
findings.action: Before a long break, compact or finish the session; a cold cache writes the whole history again.

findings.title: Your context was compacted or cleared 64 times, at 231k on average
findings.text: Every reply before that point re-read the whole context, so the longer it grows before a compaction, the more each reply costs.
findings.action: Run /compact earlier, or /clear when you switch task, instead of waiting for the automatic compaction.
